description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to maneuver instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Dexterity modifier.

Blade Defense. Roll two Sneak Attack dice, and the target attempts a Charisma save. Against the first attack it makes against you before the start of your next turn, your AC increases by the higher die result on a failed save, or the lower die result on a successful one.

Disarming Strike. The target attempts a Strength save or drops the item of your choice that it's holding; you catch it with a free hand, or it lands at your feet.

Fancy Footwork. Roll two Sneak Attack dice. Your speed increases by five times the higher of the two results, and you ignore difficult terrain until the end of the current turn.
